answer:
Promptfoo 0.123.0 defaults to the **OpenAI Responses API** for all GPT‑5.6 and newer models.

> "* **providers:** default GPT‑5.6+ to Responses ([#10803](https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10803))*" [promptfoo/0.123.0.md]

The provider documentation also notes that these model IDs “default to Responses”:

> “For GPT‑5.6 and newer models, use `openai:<model>`, such as `openai:gpt-6-luna`. These IDs default to Responses.” [promptfoo/site/docs/providers/openai.md]
